dialogues.speaker: Huihui
dialogues.text: I always thought that Liuli Pavilion was the only place to go for authentic Li cuisine...

dialogues.speaker: Huihui
dialogues.text: But it turns out that once in a while, you just can't beat a good bit of street food!

dialogues.speaker: Huihui
dialogues.text: I'm craving some more of that Zhongyuan Chop Suey...
